records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

No pressure, just a nudge: your workspace is still here whenever you're ready to pick it back up.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Quartz Labs* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and no reply to the welcome email [email:fab6edfe]; zero tickets means no engagement signal at all. Team plan suggests intent, but silence across the full first week with 8 days left makes unaided self-start unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand getting Quartz Labs started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Checking in since your Quartz Labs account opened last week. The quickest way to see value is getting a first project going — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — and then bringing someone with you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work? I can walk through your first project with you and answer anything about Wrenfield as we go.

Best,
Priya
